record.paper_title: Recent results on functional equations in a single variable, perspectives and open problems
record.context_brief: Weak uniqueness conditions for Daróczy equation
record.original_question: Find a weak additional condition that forces every positive solution φ:(0,∞)→R of Daróczy's equation φ(x) = φ(x+1) + φ(x(x+1)) to have the specific form φ(x) = c/x for some real constant c.

evidence.quote: 3. Find a weak condition under which the (positive) solution ϕ : (0,∞) → R of (6.1) is necessarily of the form ϕ(x) = c/x (6.3) with a real constant c.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider Daróczy's functional equation
  φ(x) = φ(x+1) + φ(x(x+1)),   x ∈ (0,∞),
for an unknown function φ : (0,∞) → ℝ. Note that for every real constant c, the function φ(x) = c/x is a (positive, when c>0) solution. The problem is to find a weak (i.e. as mild as possible) additional regularity, growth, monotonicity, measurability, or boundary condition on φ that, when imposed on a positive solution φ : (0,∞) → ℝ of the above equation, forces φ to be of the form φ(x) = c/x for some real constant c.
artifact.category_tag: Functional equations in a single variable
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as an open problem in the cited survey on functional equations in a single variable (2025). While various sufficient regularity conditions (e.g. continuity, monotonicity, measurability) yielding φ(x)=c/x are known for related Daróczy-type equations, no published resolution identifying a definitively "weak" sharp condition for this specific equation was found in the search. The current status is best described as open.

status_evidence.title: On the uniqueness of solutions of the functional equation ϕ(x+f(x))=ϕ(x)+ϕ(f(x))
status_evidence.snippet: Studies uniqueness of solutions to Daróczy-type functional equations under regularity assumptions, related to problems posed by Daróczy.
status_evidence.claim: Related Daróczy-type uniqueness results exist but do not resolve the question of the weakest condition for the specific equation φ(x)=φ(x+1)+φ(x(x+1)).
